description: Unexecuted template (PR-VID-MOTION-430). Bind your own images and driving videos; no media is committed and a physical run needs the owner's separate authorization of this exact suite. Both arms share the seed, source image, original driver, window and length, so the comparison is a multi-engine one: the conditioning mechanism, controls (Fun Control takes no separate motion prompt), prepared derivative and noise semantics differ together and the report discloses that. The shared envelope is 17-49 frames at 24 FPS; do not compare these clips against 81-frame Animate-2 clips. Bind each driver from the Motion Library so a converted clip carries its verified representation and movement identity; unbound drivers make a representation group exploratory. Stage 4 repeatability: one additional seed (431) for a representative upper-body case and a locomotion case under the two engines (4 jobs). Use the same source, driver and representation as the matching Stage 3 cases. Two engines and two cases are a limited sample; it does not establish broad reliability.

cases.prompt: a person standing in a plain, evenly lit studio, seen from the front, photorealistic

motion.action: Raises the right hand to shoulder height, waves it side to side twice, and lowers it.
motion.motion_prompt: the person raises their right hand and waves it side to side, then lowers it, body otherwise still
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject's right hand waves side to side at about shoulder height and returns down; the body stays in place and the hand keeps five fingers.

cases.prompt: a person standing in a plain, evenly lit studio, seen from the front, photorealistic

motion.action: Walks a few steps straight toward the camera with a natural gait.
motion.motion_prompt: the person walks forward toward the camera with a natural gait, arms swinging gently
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject takes several steps toward the camera with alternating legs and swinging arms; the background stays still and the body proportions stay stable.
